scope.workload: funded valid-deploy traffic whose pressure-bucket transitions remain within the declared rates

interpretation.worst: simultaneous adverse endpoints for every monotone parameter
interpretation.expected: central engineering assumption, not an empirical population mean
interpretation.best: simultaneous favorable endpoints for every monotone parameter

QUORUM.source: three equal stakes, docker/conf/default.conf FTT=0.1, and the strict exact finality inequality

QUEUE_CAP.source: node/src/rust/runtime/setup.rs count cap 2048; one model bucket represents 256 pending blocks

MEMORY_CAP.source: the configured aggregate node-RSS guard is partitioned into eight equal crossings above the healthy baseline; calibration must supply the deployment-specific MiB-per-bucket mapping

INITIAL_MEMORY.source: healthy measured RSS baseline at observation start; bucket zero does not mean zero resident bytes

VALIDATOR_FAILURE_RATE.source: declared per-process MTBF range of 7 to 90 days; current-branch continuous-shard telemetry is unavailable

VALIDATOR_REPAIR_RATE.source: declared mean repair/rejoin range of 15 minutes to 2 hours, encompassing heartbeat, restart, dependency retrieval, catch-up, and replay

COMMON_FAILURE_RATE.source: declared software, operator, host-domain, and network common-cause MTBF range of 30 days to 1 year

COMMON_REPAIR_RATE.source: declared common-cause mean recovery range of 15 minutes to 4 hours

STORAGE_FAILURE_RATE.source: declared durable-storage unavailability MTBF range of 90 days to 2 years

STORAGE_REPAIR_RATE.source: declared storage recovery mean range of 30 minutes to 4 hours

ARRIVAL_RATE.source: declared valid-workload pressure envelope; this is not deployments per hour

SERVICE_RATE.source: declared replay/admission relief envelope; requires queue-depth telemetry for calibration

LAG_GROWTH_RATE.unit: upward finality-lag bucket crossings per hour
LAG_GROWTH_RATE.source: declared aggregate height-difference growth envelope while peers can advance; this includes a locally protocol-ready finalizer falling behind and requires LFB time-series calibration

LAG_DRAIN_RATE.unit: downward finality-lag bucket crossings per service-hour
LAG_DRAIN_RATE.source: declared recovery envelope; heartbeat checks every 5 seconds but end-to-end catch-up is not yet calibrated

MEMORY_BACKGROUND_GROWTH_RATE.unit: upward resident-headroom bucket crossings per idle hour
MEMORY_BACKGROUND_GROWTH_RATE.source: declared residual-growth envelope spanning one normalized crossing per day to one per month; continuous current-tree RSS telemetry is required to fit it

MEMORY_WORK_GROWTH_RATE.unit: additional upward resident-headroom bucket crossings per pressure hour
MEMORY_WORK_GROWTH_RATE.source: declared workload-attributable allocation envelope while admitted work or finality lag is nonzero; queue, lag, and RSS time series are required to fit it

MEMORY_RECLAIM_RATE.unit: downward resident-headroom bucket crossings per protocol-ready hour
MEMORY_RECLAIM_RATE.source: the adverse endpoint explicitly includes a no-reclamation leak; central and favorable rates require current-tree retention and allocator telemetry

historical_context.applicability: adverse context only: old commits, shard reset between iterations, and no current-working-tree exposure; these observations are not fitted as current rates

exclusions: Byzantine safety is handled adversarially by the protocol models, not assigned a probability here.
Residual per-validator clocks are conditionally independent given the explicit common-cause state; unmodeled correlation invalidates the projection.
Waiting times are stationary and exponentially distributed within each scenario; nonstationary or heavy-tailed behavior requires a phase-type or regime-switching profile.
Disk-capacity exhaustion requires an operator-specific initial headroom and bytes-per-finalized-block profile.
The resident-memory state is normalized to configured headroom; a projection is invalid unless measured baseline RSS, guard RSS, and MiB-per-bucket are recorded for the target deployment.
A workload outside the declared pressure-transition range invalidates the projection.
A dirty working tree can produce engineering evidence but cannot produce release certification.
